additional_info.subject: RE: ID0426415-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002529] Technical Error CRM:02679000302
additional_info.body:
Hi Basheer,
Thank you for the mail.
As we discussed in Teams chat, it seems the issue is related to the configuration files. I have already shared the config files via Teams chat. As recommended, please first attempt to "restore config." action using the Live Linux script with a USB stick. If that doesn't resolve the issue, we suggest performing a CFast.
Please kindly carry a USB keyboard when visiting the site.
Step-by-Step Guide to Prepare the USB with Live Linux and Configuration Files
1. Extract the Live Linux Image
Download and install
7-Zip
if it’s not already available on your computer.
Locate the Live Linux
.img
file on your system.
Right-click on the
.img
file and choose
7-Zip > Extract Here
.
Ensure the extracted files require approximately
30GB
of space.
2. Flash the Extracted Image to a USB Drive
Obtain a
32GB USB drive
.
Download and install a tool like
Rufus tool
for flashing the image.
Open the flashing tool and:
Pendrive will be detected here.
In Select tab->Select the live Linux image
[live_linux (1).img.gz]
, then click
Start
.
Once the process is complete, click
Close
. (It normally takes some time more than 1 hour)
3. Create a Folder Named
data
Once the flashing is complete, the live Linux folders (
autorun, EFI, linux
) will be copied to the pendrive as follows.
Now, create a new folder named
'data'
here as follows:
5. Add the Configuration File
The configuration file for this unit (fhArmj) has already been sent via Teams chat.
Open the
'autorun'
folder-->go to the
'script_library'
file-
->copy the
'restore-config'
document, and paste it in
'scripts_to_run'
file
(Please note that, only script the needs to be run should be present in this folder. Delete other scripts if present already. Here, only restore-config document should be present)
Obtain the configuration file from
RnD
(in zip format). Extract the contents and copy all the files into the
'data'
folder.
Eject the pendrive
from the laptop. (Now
USB with Live Linux and Configuration Files is ready
)
Apply Live Linux USB Stick to SiCharge D
Shutdown charger
Unplug CFast Card
Plug in USB stick in -KF1’s USB port
Plug in your USB keyboard
Power on charger and wait for the Live Linux to automatically start
Observe charger UI, wait for the instruction to plug in CFast card. In some cases you might not be able to see the instructions as shown below. The waiting time depends on the script to run. Plug in the CFast card after the script-specific waiting time in case you don't see anything on the UI.
The charger will now boot from the CFast card. Wait until you see following screen.
Unplug USB stick and wait until booting is finished.
If above process does not work as expected, kindly follow the steps below:
Turn off the charger.
Remove the CFAST card.
Insert the USB keyboard into the PLC.
Insert the USB drive and reinsert the CFAST card
at the same time
.
Turn on the charger.
On the keyboard, press
ESC
when the Siemens logo appears (with the instruction to press ESC).
From the boot menu, select
Boot from USB
.
Wait for boot up.
